---
title: "Can we trust it?"
---

::: {.finding}
**We checked every hour.** Of {{n:hours_ingested}} hours read so far, {{n:flagged_hours}} were
broken at the source: far too few events, or pushes missing. They are left out of averages and
shaded on every chart. Another {{n:shifted_hours}} hours only had their mix of minor event kinds
move; they are kept.
:::

::: {.finding}
**Three independent copies agree, event by event:** the daily batch, the live stream and a fast
analytics database. They held exactly the same events in {{n:reconciled_share}} of all hours.
:::

{{fig:trust}}

Every number on these pages is recomputed from the data each time the pages are built, and the
build stops if any of them does not read back exactly.
